notenoughrainsounds.config.title: Not Enough Rain Sounds Settings
notenoughrainsounds.config.defaults_conf: Reset all Not Enough Rain Sounds settings? Changes take effect only after saving.
notenoughrainsounds.config.weather_hint: Weather sounds follow Minecraft master and weather volume.
notenoughrainsounds.config.enabled_help: Enable or disable this mod's sounds, weather replacements, and smooth pause audio. Disabling restores vanilla behavior.
notenoughrainsounds.config.volume_help: Volume of all sounds added by Not Enough Rain Sounds.
notenoughrainsounds.config.smooth_pause_: Fade all game music and sounds out when pausing and in when resuming, including vanilla and other mods. Disable to use vanilla immediate pausing.
notenoughrainsounds.config.rain_enabled_: Enable material impacts and plant drips. Background rain has separate weather settings.
notenoughrainsounds.config.rain_volume_h: Volume multiplier for material impacts and plant drips, separate from background rain.
notenoughrainsounds.config.materials_hel: Adjust each material and plant drips independently.
notenoughrainsounds.config.material_help: Exposed materials play continuously. Adjust volume, enablement and exclusions. Stone, ceramic and ground audio is not bundled yet.
notenoughrainsounds.config.plant_help: Occasional drips from plants. Independent of the foliage material switch.
notenoughrainsounds.config.material_enab: Enable this detail sound. Background rain is controlled separately.
notenoughrainsounds.config.material_volu: Adjusts this material or plant drip. Walls and roofs quiet sounds on the far side.
notenoughrainsounds.config.probability_h: Chance per plant-drip attempt only. Ordinary material rain plays continuously.
notenoughrainsounds.config.interval_help: Time between plant-drip attempts. Use arrow keys for precise adjustments. 20 ticks = 1 second.
notenoughrainsounds.config.exclusions_he: Skip material detail on matching blocks or existing tags. Their classification and background settings remain separate.
notenoughrainsounds.config.max_sounds_he: Limits simultaneous material and plant-drip layers. Complete recordings can overlap within each layer. Background and thunder are separate.
notenoughrainsounds.config.radius_help: Horizontal scan radius in blocks. Sounds still fade over 16 blocks; a larger scan does not increase audible range.
notenoughrainsounds.config.vertical_help: Vertical distance from the camera in blocks for eligible rain surfaces.
notenoughrainsounds.config.scan_interval: Ticks between surface scan batches. Lower values refresh faster but cost more work.
notenoughrainsounds.config.scan_budget_h: Maximum loaded columns checked per batch. Controls how quickly rain-exposed surfaces are discovered and refreshed.
notenoughrainsounds.config.debug_logging: Write scan and playback details to the log. Disable for normal play.
notenoughrainsounds.config.debug_particl: Show sampled surfaces using colored particles. Disable for normal play.
notenoughrainsounds.config.overrides_hel: Assign block IDs or existing tags to a material. IDs take priority over tags; within each type the first match wins.
notenoughrainsounds.config.selector_help: Use namespace:block or #namespace:tag. Tags must already exist in the current world. Click Add Rule to include the typed entry.
notenoughrainsounds.config.add_rule_help: Add the typed selector to this editing draft. Save & Return writes all changes.
notenoughrainsounds.config.remove_rule_h: Click to remove this rule from the draft. Cancel discards changes.
notenoughrainsounds.config.duplicate_rul: That block or tag already has a rule here.
notenoughrainsounds.config.save_failed: Could not save settings. Your draft is kept; check the log and try again.
notenoughrainsounds.config.replace_rain_: Uses native rain timing and positions with full mono takes for spatial playback. Walls and roofs use filtered rain at natural speed. Disabled or missing assets fall back to vanilla.
notenoughrainsounds.config.ambience_volu: Volume of the mod background rain, multiplied by Mod Volume. Separate from material drops and plant drips.
notenoughrainsounds.config.replace_thund: Selects close, medium or distant thunder recordings. Walls and roofs quiet the thunder.
notenoughrainsounds.config.thunder_volum: Replacement thunder gain, multiplied by mod and vanilla weather volume without changing propagation range.
notenoughrainsounds.config.weather_asset: Counts loaded, nonempty events: notenoughrainsounds:weather.rain, weather.rain.above and weather.thunder. Missing variants use vanilla.
notenoughrainsounds.config.weather_setup: Enable sound packs in Options → Resource Packs. Missing rain or thunder sounds fall back to vanilla.
